what: The coat of arms of each country of the game, or its emblem or its seal: the file Wikidata shows it with (P94) and the one that somebody chose for it by hand instead (scripts/data/profiles-fixes.json). items, by the id of the country: the files Wikidata names (files), in order of name, and the one chosen by hand (chosen). files: what Commons says of each file, by its title: SHA-1, bytes, MIME type, width and height of the original, licence and its address, author, credit, whether it must be attributed, restrictions other than copyright, and its page; and where the picture of it that Wikimedia draws, 330 px wide, is kept in this branch (picture): the original is not brought. The pictures are under arms/files, each named after the SHA-1 of its original.
